newsitem.title: UK: Britain pledges 250 mln stg special aid to Africa.
newsitem.headline: Britain pledges 250 mln stg special aid to Africa.

text.p: Britain has pledged up to 250 million stg in foreign exchange support over the next three years to some of Africa's poorest countries, the UK Overseas Development Administration (ODA) said on Thursday.

The aid will be distributed through the Special Programme of Assistance for Africa (SPA), co-ordinated by the World Bank. It will be linked closely to implementation of economic refrom programmes, the ODA said.
The new pledge brings Britain's comitment to SPA to over one billion stg since it was launched in 1988. At present 31 countries benefit from the SPA programme.
